verdict.rationale: Figma documents a REST API and publishes an OpenAPI specification with TypeScript types, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples. The OpenAPI spec is a developer building block that users could load into their own tools, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The probe also found no OpenAPI file served from the docs site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
